# model-router

> Choose an LLM by cost, latency and quality rules over caller-supplied model profiles, with capability filters, explained exclusions and ordered fallback Python package `trysac-model-router`, import name `model_router`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
